claims.title: Security and compliance programs
claims.precise: Security and compliance programs represented on the site badge: AICPA SOC examination language (not “SOC certified”), ISO/IEC 27001 information security management, GDPR alignment, and HIPAA compliance program alignment. Ask for the examined entity, covered system, report type, and period for any SOC report relevant to an engagement.
claims.alt: AICPA SOC; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR; HIPAA Compliant

items.label: SOC
items.wording: SOC examination available on request for the examined entity and covered system. Use Type I or Type II language from the report; do not describe SOC as a certification.

items.label: ISO/IEC 27001
items.wording: ISO/IEC 27001 information security management certification, as represented on the site badge. Request the certificate scope and validity for engagement-specific use.

items.label: GDPR
items.wording: GDPR alignment for applicable personal data processing. Not a certification.

items.label: HIPAA
items.wording: HIPAA compliance program alignment for applicable protected health information workflows. Not a certification.
